title: X (Twitter) Tweet Scraper
description: Pick at least one target (fromUsers or tweetIds). Every other field is a filter; unspecified filters mean 'no constraint' and filters combine with AND semantics.

fromUsers.title: From users
fromUsers.description: Handles whose recent tweets should be scraped, without the leading @. Backed by X's profile timeline operation, which is reachable with a guest token.

tweetIds.title: Tweet IDs
tweetIds.description: Specific tweet IDs to hydrate into the full output schema.

searchTerms.title: Search terms (NOT SUPPORTED — see README)
searchTerms.description: Free-text search. NOT SUPPORTED by this Actor: X's SearchTimeline operation is auth-walled to guest tokens, and this Actor deliberately uses guest tokens only. Supplying this field fails the run with an explicit error rather than silently returning nothing. See the README for the evidence behind that conclusion.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Keep only tweets containing all of these hashtags, without the leading #. Applied as a post-filter over the fetched timelines.

since.title: Since (inclusive)
since.description: Keep only tweets created on or after this date (ISO date, e.g. 2025-01-01).

until.title: Until (inclusive)
until.description: Keep only tweets created on or before this date (ISO date, e.g. 2025-12-31).

language.title: Language
language.description: Keep only tweets whose detected language matches this ISO-639-1 code, e.g. 'en' or 'es'.

minLikes.title: Minimum likes
minLikes.description: Keep only tweets with at least this many likes.

minRetweets.title: Minimum retweets
minRetweets.description: Keep only tweets with at least this many retweets.

minReplies.title: Minimum replies
minReplies.description: Keep only tweets with at least this many replies.

onlyVerified.title: Only verified authors
onlyVerified.description: Keep only tweets whose author is verified (legacy verified or X Premium blue check).

mediaType.title: Media type
mediaType.description: Keep only tweets carrying this kind of media.
enumTitles: Text only — no media and no links
Video — at least one video or animated GIF
Links — at least one external URL

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Ordering, for the surfaces that support it. X's profile timeline is served newest-first, so 'top' is applied by this Actor as an engagement sort over what was fetched.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: How many items you want. NOTE: free-tier runs are capped server-side at 10 items regardless of this value; raising it cannot lift that cap.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Residential rotation is supported; pick the RESIDENTIAL group and optionally a country.
